summary: All 4 tests pass. The fix was in `middleware.go:18` — the middleware was checking the raw `r.URL.Path` while the router was normalizing paths via `path.Clean()`, creating a mismatch that allowed `//api/admin` and `/health/../api/data` to bypass authentication. The fix applies the same `path.Clean()` normalization in the middleware before the `/api/` prefix check.
